connector.name: QuoteFirst
connector.registryDescription: Get dollar quotes from 200+ LLMs before any work runs; accept, execute, and verify quality.
connector.summary: Hosted at quotefirst.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.quotefirst, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token using your QuoteFirst API key (create one in Settings at quotefirst.ai). Format: Bearer qf_your_key
